entry.title: dotnet/aspnetcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-10-23
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Sign aspnetcore runtime archives and publish detached signatures as part official builds #64146
  • SignalR: Empty /negotiate response with HTTP 200 when .net 8 app hosted on IIS from Microsoft.AspNetCore.Connections.Abstractions version 9.x onwards #64144
  • Blazor Virtualization flickers when scrolling #64142

Closed

  • Update CookieAuthenticationOptions comments #64074
  • [OpenAPI] Integers represented as both integer/string even when AddJsonOptions sets NumberHandling to Strict #64145
  • Getting developer exception page when didn't enable it #64140
  • [Blazor] InputBase does not update FieldIdentifier when bound model instance changes #64134
  • SseFormatter.WriteAsync does not flush after writing an event #64118

PullRequests

Merged

  • Update CookieAuthenticationOptions XML documentation to clarify ExpireTimeSpan usage #64122
    Attention: Shared Code Modified, 11.0-preview1

Updated

  • Enhanced navigation should not scroll before content renders #64054
    area-blazor, 10.0.x
  • Blazor 404 code re-execution is compatible with `OnNavigateAsync` #64034
    area-blazor, 10.0.x
  • Add support for .slnx file exclusion in BaselineTest #62767
    area-mvc, community-contribution, pending-ci-rerun, 11.0-preview1
  • Fix ResponseCompression tests to work with different zlib implementations #63988
    community-contribution, pending-ci-rerun, area-middleware
  • [SignalR] Add parameter index to invocation binding exception message #64016
    area-signalr, pending-ci-rerun
  • [release/10.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #64127
    area-infrastructure, Type: Dependency Update :arrow_up_small:
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #64100
    area-infrastructure, Type: Dependency Update :arrow_up_small:, build-ops
